def dotpos(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.splitlines()
    rp=[(i,j) for i in range(0,52) for j,c in enumerate(a[i]) if c=='r']
    # plus is 4 px cross; dot is the isolated 1px
    from collections import Counter
    return rp
print("before dot/plus:", dotpos(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':27}]*5, intent='explore')
print("after 5 S-grows:", dotpos(current_frame))
def seginfo(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.splitlines(); out={}
    for ch in 'OSYN':
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(0,52) for j,c in enumerate(a[i]) if c==ch]
        if pts:
            rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            out[ch]=(len(pts),min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return out
print("segs:", seginfo(current_frame))
